paper_title: Dual Modality-Aware Gated Prompt Tuning for Few-Shot Multimodal Sarcasm   Detection
caption: Effect of Prompt Length
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between prompt length and accuracy for two different models, mmsd and mmsd2. The x-axis represents prompt length, with a linear scale, ranging from 2 to 16, and tick labels at intervals of 2. The y-axis represents accuracy, also with a linear scale, ranging from 77 to 81, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The red line, representing mmsd, starts at an accuracy of 81.1 at a prompt length of 2, decreases to 80.4 at a prompt length of 4, increases to 80.8 at a prompt length of 8, and then gradually decreases to 80.7 at a prompt length of 16, with a solid line style and circular markers. The orange line, representing mmsd2, begins at an accuracy of 77.4 at a prompt length of 2, decreases to 76.7 at a prompt length of 4, increases to 77.2 at a prompt length of 8, and then declines to 76.4 at a prompt length of 16, also with a solid line style and circular markers.
